runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Alpha 3 Skills and explorer/explainer roles copied into a disposable Git fixture; empty Skill allowlist; asynchronous task support enabled; request restricted inspection to repository-generated resources.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow contract in a disposable repository with auto-approved inspection commands

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated poteto-mode router from the disposable fixture.
The root and children used the fixture's generated Skills and roles; the session contains no installed plugin-cache lookup.
The router selected investigation for a read-only multi-module explanation request.
The investigation playbook loaded the generated how Skill and followed its complex path.
ExplorerAEntryQueue and ExplorerBWorkerStore started as one parallel pair before either result was awaited.
Exactly two attributable explorer results were frozen locally with no follow-up, retry, or replacement.
ExplainerReportFlow was the only explainer and started after both explorer results froze.
The explainer received and preserved the independently attributable entry/queue and worker/store findings.
The root re-read the public entry, queue, worker, renderer, store, submitter, and integration test before answering.

The final answer correctly explained createReportSystem composition, validation and normalization, ID assignment, FIFO dequeue, rendering, frozen storage, null-on-empty behavior, and caller-driven processing.
Git status was clean and all seven fixture source hashes matched the committed fixture.

limitations: No independently useful child model identity was extracted, so this record makes no model-diversity claim.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
